dataset.title: TimeMachine-bench (human-verified subset)
dataset.evaluationQuestion: Given a real Python repository whose historical dependency state no longer resolves or runs, does Drift detect the dependency change and identify the repository as affected?
dataset.doesNotEstablish: No precision and no false-positive rate, for the same reason as swe-bump-bench: the corpus is migration failures, so every case is a positive.

groundTruth.basis: Human-verified migration failures. Positives only; no non-failing control migrations.
